format: 
  html:
    page-layout: full

<div class="mt-4 text-end text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">
City ID: <span id="city-id"></span>
</div>


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(DT)
library(dplyr)

source("helpers.R")

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv", check.names = FALSE)

datatable(dat[, c("ID", "Tick species", "Publication year", "ArticleTitle", "LID", "DOI")], ,
          escape = FALSE, 
          style = "bootstrap5",
          class = "wrap",
          filter = "top",
          extensions = c("Select", "SearchPanes", "Buttons"), 
          selection = "none",
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 50,
            dom = "PBfrtip",
            buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
            searchPanes = list(initCollapsed = TRUE, viewCount = FALSE),
            columnDefs = list(
              list(targets = c(0, 2:5), searchPanes = list(show = FALSE)),
              list(targets = 0, render = render_collection),
              list(targets = 1, 
                   searchPanes = list(show = TRUE, orthogonal = "sp"),
                   render = JS("function(data, type, row, meta) {
                                  if (type === 'sp') {
                                    return data ? data.split(',').map(function(item) { return item.trim(); }) : data;
                                  }
                                return data;
                               }")),
              list(targets = 3, render = render_publication_doi(5)),
              list(targets = 4, visible = FALSE),
              list(targets = 5, visible = FALSE)
            ),
            initComplete = JS("
      async function(settings, json) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        
        let city = decodeURIComponent(window.location.search.substring(1));
        
        if (city) {
          const el = document.getElementById('city-id');
          el.textContent = city;
          
          let cityName = await getResultValue('intermediates/cities.json', 'City');
          let countryName = await getResultValue('intermediates/cities.json', 'Country');

          $('h1.title').text('Publications from ' + cityName + ' (' + countryName + ')');
          document.title = 'Publications from ' + cityName;
  
          console.log('city');
          var api = this.api();
          api.column(4).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(city) + '$', true, false).draw();
        } 
      }
    "))
)

```
